info.title: Distru Public API - CRM
info.description: Reconciled with live wire shapes 2026-05-25. See categories/crm.md for full field grids and the reconciliation note covering 17 phantom fields removed + several wire-only fields added.

get.description: List companies. Page size 5,000. NO relationship_type filter (tenant-customizable enum — silently ignored). NO tags[] filter (not in wire). Companies unify customers AND vendors via the relationship_type {id,name}|null object.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: Tri-state. `include` returns soft-deleted rows with deleted_at populated.

200.description: Paginated companies (~25 fields per record — see categories/crm.md)

post.description: UPSERT. id optional for create. outstanding_balance_threshold is in INTEGER CENTS (not decimal dollars).

get.description: List contacts. Page size 1,000. NO tags[] filter (not in wire). Note: contacts emit `phone_number`/`description`/`work_phone_number` etc., NOT the previously-documented `phone`/`notes` field names.

200.description: Paginated contacts (~17 paths per record — see categories/crm.md)

post.description: UPSERT. DO NOT send full_name — server-derived from first_name+last_name; sending it returns HTTP 400.

get.description: List locations. Page size 1,000. Address is a single concatenated string, not structured. Returns BOTH license_id (always scalar UUID) AND license (MIXED TYPE — sometimes {id,license_number} object, sometimes plain string). When nested inside /companies.locations[], only license_id is present (no license field at all). Use license_id as the stable join key.

200.description: Paginated locations (7 fields per record). NOTE: is_shipping/is_billing/is_archived are NOT in wire despite earlier docs.
